reports.title: Jacobs Reports Strong Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

lines: The Company’s outlook for fiscal 2027 is for adjusted net revenue to range from $10.0B to $10.35B, adjusted EBITDA margin to range from 15.4% to 15.7%, adjusted EPS to range from $8.05 to $8.45 and for free cash flow margin to range from 8.5% to 9.5%.
